command.description: Command that starts the server (stdio), for a server that isn't a package

package.description: The package that is the server (stdio), instead of a command

npm.description: npm package (name@version): run by Kaja's own bun, else npx or pnpm dlx

pypi.description: PyPI package (name@version, its command named like it): run by uvx or pipx

docker.description: Docker image (name:tag or name@sha256:digest): docker run, when nothing else can start it

args.description: The server's own arguments (after the package, with one)

env.description: Static env vars for the server (stdio)

keyless.description: The server works without a key too (e.g. with lower limits), so the ability is on without one

approval.description: When tool calls ask first: writes = unless the tool is marked read-only

tools.description: Only these of the server's tools reach the model

toolDescriptions.description: What each listed tool does, in a line, for the web's tool list (the server's own text only arrives at run time)

trustedSandbox.description: In the cloud, only the user's own MCP sandboxes or the official one run it, never one another person shares (stdio)

roots.description: The server works in folders the persona gives it (its abilities entry's `roots`), sent as MCP roots; off for a persona that gives none (stdio)

pathArgs.description: Tool arguments that hold paths, for a `roots` server: a write into a folder a persona made read-only is refused (without these, read-only folders are left out)

localOnly.description: Only runs on the user's own machine, never in the cloud (e.g. it works on their files)

localOnlyArgs.description: Tool arguments that only make sense on the user's own machine (e.g. a file path to save to); the cloud hides them

readOnly.description: Tools to treat as read-only under approval = "writes", for servers that don't mark them

unless.description: Arguments that make a call a write when set
